# Check if user exists in LDAP via postfix
postmap -q mail1 ldap:/etc/postfix/ldap-users.cf

# Check if mailbox path is returned correctly
postmap -q mail1 ldap:/etc/postfix/ldap-mailbox.cf

# Check active postfix configuration
postconf | grep virtual
postconf | grep mynetworks
postconf | grep sasl

# Check mail queue
postqueue -p

# Flush mail queue (retry stuck emails)
postqueue -f

# Delete all queued emails
postsuper -d ALL

# Reload postfix config
postfix reload
